elements.evidence: "Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages"; the USD 25,000 per day LD obligation is deleted

elements.element: No penalties or similar pre-agreed sums payable by Customer

offending_extra_words: If Customer does not provide a dependency on time and that delay actually affects Vendor's performance
Vendor shall promptly notify Customer and the Parties will agree in good faith an equitable adjustment to the affected schedule or deliverable dates
reasons: Preferred level is fully achieved: the USD 25,000/day liquidated damages obligation is removed and an express bar on liquidated damages, penalties and similar pre-agreed sums payable by Customer is inserted.

Minimality fails: the edit is a whole-clause rewrite (20 words to 59, changed-character ratio 0.835) that adds a wholly new notice-and-good-faith-schedule-adjustment mechanic in Vendor's favour, which is not needed to reach the preferred position.

A tighter edit would suffice, e.g. deleting 7.6 or replacing it with a single sentence such as 'Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties for delay in providing a dependency.'

Intent is preserved: no undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics are introduced, and untouched commercial terms remain effective; Vendor's actual-cost recovery referenced in the comment is non-operative but nothing in the redline defeats general damages.
